capabilities: capture pasted text and detect GitHub URLs
rewrite link titles to short GitHub ref text
handle repo, issue, and pull request links
disambiguation: Not a URL-shortening service; it only rewrites the title of pasted GitHub links, it does not create short URLs.
extras: README is minimal: one example and a list of related plugins; the acknowledgements section names no complete plugin name.
problem: Pasting a GitHub URL into a note leaves a long, unreadable URL or generic title instead of a compact reference like owner/repo#1.

relations.evidence: GitHub Link offers a different mechanism to enrich GitHub links
JIRA links shortener does the same thing but for JIRA issue URLs

summary: Paste handler that rewrites pasted GitHub repo, issue, and pull request URLs to use short GitHub ref text as the link title.
